application_credentials.description: Create an app registration in [Microsoft Entra]({console_url}) for personal Microsoft accounts. Add this exact redirect URI under the Mobile and desktop applications platform: `{redirect_uri}`. Use authorization code with PKCE and leave the client secret blank.

user.title: Connect Microsoft email
user.description: Choose how much email content Home Assistant may read. Metadata-only requests basic message properties only. Short summaries require the broader Mail.Read permission and retrieve message text locally. Your selected Outlook folder is a query filter, not a Microsoft-enforced permission boundary.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthorize Microsoft email
reauth_confirm.description: Microsoft authorization has expired or been revoked. Reconnect the account to continue.

abort.already_configured: A Microsoft mailbox is already configured.

init.title: Choose Outlook folder
init.description: Select the folder where your Outlook rule delivers ParentSquare notifications. This is an application-level filter; it does not narrow Microsoft's OAuth permission. Configure the sender domains used to filter incoming messages; this is a filtering rule, not sender authentication. Optional child rules use the format Child label: keyword1, keyword2. A message is assigned only when exactly one rule matches; ambiguous messages stay unassigned. In metadata-only mode, matching uses the subject; summary mode can also match the locally extracted short summary.

abort.no_mail_folders: No Outlook mail folders were returned for this account.
